## Ingredients
- 300 g sweet provolone cheese
- 100 g breadcrumbs
- 1 egg
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste pepper,
## Method
1. Cut the cheese into slices or pieces, dip it in the beaten egg with a pinch of pepper, drain, and coat the cheese in the breadcrumbs, pressing it lightly with your hands to make it adhere well.
2. Heat the oil in a frying pan and immerse the cheese slices in it.
3. Brown them evenly, drain them with the appropriate spatula, and place them on kitchen paper towels.
4. Serve them immediately.
